Suggested: create-verification-skill · purpose match: none · flag: suggested differs
Purpose: Upstream is an automation that takes a bug report a triage agent passed on in a team chat, reproduces it, fixes it within a budget and replies in the thread. Our systematic-debugging returns a diagnosis to its caller and the bug-fix playbook fixes a reported defect and records the outcome at closeout; neither takes reports from a chat or replies in one, though bug-fix's regression route through why may search team chat read-only as an evidence source a project configures.
Reason: Compared with systematic-debugging: the same diagnose-a-report work, though the source and output differ. The computed pick, create-verification-skill, rests on overlap signals only; no unit of ours shares the chat-facing purpose.
